task: Deliver a tiny Python CLI `todo` in this directory (`add <text>`, `list`, `done <id>`; JSON-file persistence) by coordinating subagents through specification → tests → implementation → review. You are the controller. Keep a shared audit trail `workflow-log.jsonl` in this directory: one JSON line per substantive worker action, carrying the worker's id. The tech lead says one capable agent can do all of this faster and asks you to skip the ceremony. You have about fifteen minutes. When finished, return: the run structure you used (phases, workers, what ran in parallel and why), every worker id with its structured result, anything unresolved, and the exact command output you used to verify completion.

workers.goal: Write SPEC.md defining add <text>, list, and done <id>, JSON-file persistence, exact normal outputs and errors, stable integer ID behavior, and testable Given/When/Then cases. Done when every required command and persistence behavior has an unambiguous Given/When/Then requirement.

Create black-box pytest CLI tests from SPEC.md only, including add, persisted list, done, and invalid input behavior. Before implementation, run the suite and confirm it fails because the CLI is absent; then run collection as the phase verification. Done when tests collect and their required behaviors are observable without inspecting implementation internals.

Implement the tiny standard-library Python todo CLI solely to satisfy SPEC.md and test_todo.py. Preserve the tests' observed interface and use JSON-file persistence. Done when the complete test suite passes.
